post.description: Import words the client already parsed (a pasted list, a Quizlet or Anki export) into one unit: the unit with this title, else a new one at the end.

get.description: Home screen summary: reviews due now per course and in total, and a forecast of reviews per day (today includes overdue ones) in the given time zone.

Progress for every course, or one: words learned, reviews done, retention over the last 30 days, reviews per day for 12 weeks, the current and longest streak of review days, and the hardest words. Days are counted in the given time zone.
learn: the next unseen items in course order. review: items whose card is due, most overdue first.
Review across all courses: items whose card is due, most overdue first. Each item names its course and that course's grading.

post.description: Grade a typed answer (server-authoritative), update the FSRS card and log the review.
